name: Storytelling
measures: Whether a piece moves: a setup, a turn and a payoff, concrete detail, rising tension, varied rhythm and a landing.
limitations: Arc detection uses marker phrases. A story told without them ('Then.' 'Now.') scores lower than it should.
It measures structure, not whether the story is interesting or true.
Short pieces (under ~40 words) rarely score well; use the hook rubric for those.

criteria.label: Arc
criteria.measures: Setup, turn and payoff are all present.

rules.why: Count of setup / turn / payoff signals present (0-3).
rules.fix: Add the missing beat: when it happened, what went wrong, what changed.
Swap an abstraction for the real detail.

rules.why: A person in the story ('I', 'we') makes it a story rather than advice.
Variation in sentence length (coefficient of variation).
rules.fix: Mix a few very short sentences with longer ones.

criteria.label: Landing
criteria.measures: Ends on an ask or a point, not a fade.

rules.why: The last lines tell the viewer what to do or think.
